title: TWO MEN ONE COAST
style: Cinematic Australian coastal anthem, 98 BPM, atmospheric electric guitar arpeggios in intro, deep rolling toms, wide reverb snare, layered harmony vocals in chorus, melodic bass supportive not dominant, gradual build structure, half-time reflective bridge, final chorus with full harmonic stack, subtle didgeridoo drone under final chorus only, long reverb tail outro
lyrics:
[INTRO – clean guitar + ocean swell]

[HOOK – soft, then build]
Two men
One coast
Western sky
That’s what we chose

[VERSE 1 – Pete]
Captain steady
Reads the reef
Every channel
Underneath

Swan calm water
Rottnest line
Ocean rhythm
Runs in time

[VERSE 2 – Brandon]
Steel and structure
Cut and weld
Livewire rising
Iron held

Pelican steady
Decks alive
Built the fleet
To survive

[PRE-CHORUS – Dual harmony rising]
From Carnac drift
To coral north
From Perth lights
To open course

[CHORUS – Full lift]
Two men
One coast
Indian Ocean
What we know most

Two boats
Running strong
Western Australian water
Where we belong

[VERSE 3]
Bucks nights
Birthday flame
Corporate run
Same domain

BYO cold
Sunset clear
Every charter
Earned out here

[BRIDGE – Half-time reflective]
You don’t rent a coastline
You earn every mile
Steel, salt, time
And trial

[FINAL CHORUS – Full harmonic stack]
Two men
One coast
Pelican steady
Livewire host

Two men
One coast
Western sky
That’s what we chose

[OUTRO – reverb fade]
